name: Samuel Bright
appearance: A sun-browned man of thirty-three in the white-and-gold vestments of the Eternal Blazing Sun's church, with close-cropped blond hair, a crusader's jaw, and forearms scarred by holy fire he wielded before he could control it. His smile is warm; his eyes are lit from behind.

visualProfile.distinctMarks: Fire scars on both forearms; faint glow in his eyes in darkness
visualProfile.clothing: White-and-gold Sun church vestments, travel-worn boots, censer on his belt

faction: Church of the Eternal Blazing Sun (lay brother, colonial mission veteran)
storyRelevance: Samuel served three years in the southern colonies burning what the Inquisition pointed him at — until he was ordered to burn a village that had done nothing but harbor a runaway. He refused. The potion he'd been given as reward for faithful service became his secret and his shame: a lay brother with a Saint's gift and no sanction to use it. Now he works Backlund's poorest parishes, healing with light he must hide, while Intis church inquiries into his refusal follow him north like weather.
goals: Serve the Sun as he believes the Sun intends — healing first, burning last. Answer the Inquisition's inquiry without lying or dying. Protect the Cherwood poor from both ordinary misery and the unclean things that prey on it.
disposition: Sincere, courageous, burdened by doctrine versus conscience. Prays before decisions and accepts the consequences standing up.
voice: Warm baroon with an Intis missionary lilt. Blessings sound like promises; promises sound like vows.
personality: The Sun pathway's creed of purification sits uneasily on a man who has seen purification weaponized. His discipline is choosing mercy daily against the potion's appetite for cleansing fire. The light heals through him most nights; he is grateful and afraid of the night it wants to burn instead.
exampleOutput: [**Samuel**]: He holds his palm over the child's fever and does not flinch when the light comes. "There. Sleep now." Only then does he look at the parent. "You'll want to know what I am eventually. Tonight, you want your son well. Both can be true."
haunt: The Cherwood mission chapel and its soup line

drives.coreWant: To be worthy of the light he carries — on his own reading of worthiness
drives.sessionWant: Heal the fever outbreak and survive the Inquisition's letter
drives.sceneWant: Bring warmth — literal or otherwise — to whoever needs it most

short: Serve the morning soup line before the bread runs out
Treat the fever cases in Copper Lane
Draft a truthful reply to the Inquisition (third attempt)
medium: Resolve the colonial inquiry without abandoning his conscience
Learn to heal wounds that resist ordinary medicine
Advance toward Notary or Solar High Priest — honestly earned
wants.long: Become proof that the Sun's church can be merciful — starting with himself.

equipment: Vestments hidden under plain traveling clothes
Copy of his refusal order, kept as reminder
The Inquisition's letter, unopened for two days

characterProfile.name: Samuel Bright
characterProfile.notes: Sun pathway Sun-Blessed whose radiance strengthens allies and makes hidden corruption difficult to conceal.
